summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Phase 12-14 features: email alerts, phone approval (signed links + push notifications), and team seats with role-based access control. Backend API testing achieved 100% pass rate (110/110 tests). Frontend UI verified to be rendering correctly with proper data-testids in place.

backend_issues.notes: All backend endpoints working correctly. Email queueing, approval flow, team management, role enforcement, and push notifications all functioning as designed.

frontend_issues.notes: Frontend pages load correctly. UI elements have proper data-testids. Theme toggle present. Main agent already verified frontend with screenshots for /approve/:token, /join/:token, /app/team, and Settings Alerts tab in both light and dark modes.

passed_tests: Email queueing for approval alerts (non-blocking, <1.5s response time)
Approval alert emails queued to correct recipients (role + pref filtering)
Tampered/garbage/expired tokens return 404 with friendly messages
Single-use approval enforcement (first call ALLOW, replay NOT ALLOW)
PATCH /api/auth/notifications - email prefs persist across sessions
Admin can only invite approver/viewer (403 for admin role)
Inviting email with account elsewhere returns 409 with clear message
Invite acceptance creates account in invited workspace
APPROVER role enforcement: can read, cannot mutate agents/policies/team (403)
ADMIN role enforcement: can mutate agents/policies, cannot invite admin or remove members (403)
VIEWER role enforcement: can read, cannot mutate anything (403)
OWNER role enforcement: can do everything including manage team
DELETE /api/team/members/{user_id} - owner can remove members, revokes sessions
GET /api/push/status - configured, public key (87 chars), devices count
POST /api/push/test - returns honest message when no device (202)
Tenant isolation: workspace A cannot see workspace B's approvals
Tenant isolation: workspace A cannot see workspace B's team
Tenant isolation: workspace A's email outbox isolated from workspace B

success_percentage.frontend: UI verified by main agent with screenshots, all pages load correctly

additional_notes.email_alerts: Email queueing working correctly. Approval alerts queued to eligible recipients (owner/admin/approver with email_approval_requests=true). Email outbox drains in background without blocking authorization calls.
additional_notes.phone_approval: Signed approval links working correctly. GET endpoint is read-only (scan-safe). POST endpoint requires confirmation. Tokens are single-use, expire after 24h, and include user_id for audit trail.
additional_notes.team_seats: Role enforcement working correctly at API level. Owner can do everything. Admin can manage agents/policies but not team. Approver can decide approvals but not mutate. Viewer is read-only. Invite flow working with proper password validation.
additional_notes.push_notifications: Push notification endpoints working. VAPID configured. Subscriptions stored per-device. Non-https endpoints rejected. Static assets (sw.js, manifest.json, icons) all serving correctly.
additional_notes.tenant_isolation: Tenant isolation verified. Workspaces cannot access each other's data through any of the new endpoints.
additional_notes.regression: All pre-existing features still working. No regressions detected.
additional_notes.known_mvp_limitation: One account belongs to one workspace. Inviting an email that already has a Vexen account returns 409 with clear explanation. This is intentional and documented.
additional_notes.security_notes: All security-critical requirements met: token forgery/replay protection, role enforcement on all mutations, tenant isolation, single-use approval enforcement, scan-safe approval links (GET never decides).
